reviews.corroborating_transcription: Award of Request for Proposal No. 9144-13-7033 to Data Direct Group Inc. for Notification Services to Individuals Charged Under the Provincial Offences Act Consideration Type: ACTION Wards: All Origin (June 7, 2013) Report from the Director, Purchasing and Materials Management Recommendations The Director of Purchasing and Materials Management recommends that the Bid Committee grant authority to award the following contract: Call No: RFP No. 9144-13-7033 Description: The purpose of this RFP is to select a printing and document management Vendor to print and mail notices to offenders as and when required by the Court Services Division for a period of two (2) years from January 2, 2014 to December 31, 2015, with the option to renew the contract for an additional three (3) separate one (1) year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval(s). Should the option be exercised, then the Director of Court Services will request the Director of Purchasing and Materials Management to process the renewal under the same terms and conditions. Recommended Proponent: Data Direct Group Inc. Contract Award Value: $394,800.00 net of all applicable taxes and charges $446,124.00 including all applicable taxes and charges $401,748.50 net of HST recoveries Contract is expected to start on January 2, 2014 and end on December 31, 2015. Option Year 1 - January 1, 2016 to December 31, 2016 $197,400.00 net of all applicable taxes and charges $223,062.00 including all applicable taxes and charges $200,874.25 net of HST recoveries Option Year 2 - January 1, 2017 to December 31, 2017 $197,400.00 net of all applicable taxes and charges $223,062.00 including all applicable taxes and charges $200,874.25 net of HST recoveries Option Year 3 - January 1, 2018 to December 31, 2018 $197,400.00 net of all applicable taxes and charges $223,062.00 including all applicable taxes and charges $200,874.25 net of HST recoveries The total potential contract award including all option years is $987,000,00 net of all applicable taxes and charges $1,115,310.00 including all applicable taxes and charges. The total potential cost to the City including all option years is $1,004,371.25 net of HST recoveries. Summary Ward No: All Call Dates: Issued: March 26, 2013 Closed: April 17, 2013 No. of Addenda Issued: Two (2) Number of Proposals: A total of ten (10) Proposals from the following Proponents were received: Canada Post Corporation* CDS Global Inc.* Cover-All Computer Services Corp.* Data Direct Group Inc. DATA Group Ltd. DT&P Inc.* Formost Data Products Inc. Lowe-Martin Company Inc. RICOH Canada Inc.* Yvelo Mailng Services Inc.* Four (4) Proposals met the 75 percent technical threshold ( ≥56.3 points) and had their costs evaluated. * The Proposal did not meet the mandatory technical threshold. Range of Scores 68.32 to 89.26 Division Contacts Victor Tryl Manager, Professional Services Purchasing and Materials Management Telephone: 416-397-4801 Email: vtryl@toronto.ca Philip Arhinson Manager, Finance and Administration Court Services Tel: 416-338-7362 E-mail: parhinso@toronto.ca Financial Impact The total potential contract award including all option years identified in this report is $1,115,310.00 including all applicable taxes and charges. The total potential cost to the City including all option years is $1,004,371.25 net of HST recoveries. Funding in the amount of $197,400.00 is included in the Court Services' 2014 Base Operating Budget under CT5000 (Planning and Liaison), Cost Element 4825. Funding in the amount of $197,400.00 will be included in the Court Services' 2015 Operating Budget Submission for the second year of the contract . Should the City choose to exercise its option years, then appropriate additional funding, if needed, will be included in the 2016-2018 Operating Budget Submissions, under the same charge accounts and cost centres.
